[IAOT.2.5] The object file format (`ELF`, `Mach-O`, `COFF`) is
determined by the host toolchain.  The compiler uses an `objcopy`
equivalent to extract the laid-out bytes — `objcopy` under binutils,
`llvm-objcopy` under LLVM — discovered from the toolchain rather than
assumed, and overridable via `DS_OBJCOPY` or `--objcopy`
([IAOT.2.4]).  The bytes embedded in the `body` field are always the
raw machine instructions, not an object file.
